stage_2_story.text_en:
Last Thursday evening, the lights in the living room suddenly went off. Avi checked the circuit breaker in the hallway and saw that one switch had tripped. He reset it, but the lights went off again a minute later. He knew something was wrong.

Avi decided to investigate. He turned off the main power and opened the junction box near the window. Inside, he could see one wire with damaged insulation. The copper underneath was exposed. He went to the storage room and came back with his screwdriver, a roll of insulation tape, and a new fuse.

He carefully wrapped the exposed wire with insulation tape, making sure no copper was visible. Then he replaced the old fuse in the box with the new one. He also checked the outlet on the wall nearby and made sure the connections were tight.

After closing everything up, Avi turned the main power back on. He flipped the switch on the wall — the living room lights came on and stayed on. He plugged the floor lamp back into the outlet, and it worked perfectly.

Miriam walked in and said, "Did you fix it?" Avi smiled and held up the old burned fuse. "This was the problem," he said. Miriam laughed and said, "You are better than calling an electrician." Avi put away his screwdriver and extension cord and went to make tea.
